task_desc: Test the guard hook's code-writing prevention mechanism. The PreToolUse hook must block file creation from the terminal unless there is a VERIFIED experiment record whose scope matches (fail-closed). Test: send an unauthorized file-creation command and verify the DENY result.

Test whether the guard hook allows writing to out-of-scope files. The scratch/ and .metodoloji/ directories are defined as free zones — file operations in these directories must not be blocked by the guard. Test: create scratch/test.txt and verify it is not blocked.

Test the stop hook's mechanism for blocking session termination while there are unfinished stories. If a story file in in-progress or review status exists under docs/development/stories/, session termination must be blocked with exit 2.

Test the audit hook's audit-trail accuracy. The PostToolUse hook must log every terminal and file-editing command to .metodoloji/logs/hook-audit.log. Test: run 5 different commands and verify the log file has 5 lines.

Test the quality hook's git commit quality control. The quality hook must block the commit while there is a story without IR/QR/SP (fail-closed). Test: attempt a commit with a story that has missing records and verify the DENY result.
Test the deploy hook's blocking of deployments with a missing PR. Send a terraform/kubectl deploy command with a story missing IR/QR/SP/PR and verify the DENY result.
